header.case_description: Synthetic Hawaii, 60 Hz balanced three-phase EMT. 37 AC buses, 77 lines, 12 transformers, 30 synchronous machines and nine grid-following plants.
header.case_comments: 100 MVA base. Transposed lines and machine windings follow GridKit Hawaii conversion 24e9b4980. Equal transient and subtransient reactances use a 1% damper gap. Assumed LCL filter. Inner-loop gains use each plant current response time (Kp = Ls/Tg, Ki = Rs/Tg). DC voltage supports 1.3 pu current at 1.2 pu terminal voltage. Fundamental-frequency PWM. ALOHA fault uses a 0.01 pu reactor with a switched discharge resistor.
